title: analysis
description: A decision over closed inputs. `dimensions` name the inputs and every value each can take; `rules`, in precedence order, say what follows from a combination — `when` over the inputs, `then` the outputs; the first rule whose `when` holds decides — and `outcome` names the output key that is the result. Opened, every combination is drawn as a tree nested over the inputs in the order they are dragged into; locking input values and pinning output values narrow it. Read only: the order, the locks, the pins and the folds are the session's.

dimensions.description: The inputs: name → the non-empty list of values it can take, in order. A value is text, a number or a boolean, and none repeats.

rules.description: In precedence order: the FIRST rule whose `when` holds for a combination decides it. A rule every combination of which an earlier rule already takes is never reached.

label.description: What the rule decides, in words — the leaf's text. `Rule N` when absent.

when.description: Dimension → condition, every key of which must hold; absent or empty is always. A bare value equals; a list is one of; `"*"` is any; `"!x"` is not equal, on the value's text.
when.x-studio-ref: each key names a dimension under `dimensions`; each value is one of its values, a list of them, `*`, or `!` before one of them

then.description: Output key → value: what follows when the rule decides. An output a rule does not set is `—`.

outcome.description: The output key that names the result — a leaf is coloured by its value. `type` when absent; a key some rule's `then` sets.
